plugin.name: Landledger
plugin.description: Landledger cost ledger: budgets, spend and the cost of a window, contracts' seats, requests, reservations, periods, the close's frozen snapshot and variance note drafts, a person's signed Slack press relayed for Landledger to verify, and a webhook trigger for requests, confirmations, decisions, seats, budgets, periods, the close, notes and reports; reachable over HTTP, gRPC, any installed broker and MCP
plugin.author: Landflow

nodes.name: landledger
nodes.description: Check a cost center's budget, query spend and the cost of services over a window, find a contract's seats, read a closing month's frozen snapshot, draft its variance notes, raise and read spend requests, release a seat request's seats, reserve and release budget, read a month's status, and relay a person's signed Slack approval to Landledger
nodes.subtitle: {{operation}}: {{resource}}
nodes.toolDescription: Landledger, the cost ledger: check what a cost center has left this month after actuals and reservations (and whether a planned amount fits), query spend grouped by cost center, team, service, agent, model…, the estimated cost of named services over a time window, read a closing month's frozen snapshot and the figures its variance notes may cite, submit a draft of a variance note (a person accepts it), raise a spend request (an agent always names its sponsor, the accountable person) and read its status and evidence, reserve or release budget for an approved request, and read whether a month is open, closing or locked. Agents request; people decide: no tool here approves or rejects.

options.name: Check
options.description: What a cost center has left in a month after actuals and reservations, and whether a planned amount fits

options.name: Snapshot
options.description: A closing month's frozen figures (by cost center, P&L class, provider, the accrual, the notes' figures) and their sha256; Landledger answers 404 before the accrual is accepted

options.name: Figures
options.description: The notes a closing month needs (the whole month and each cost center) with the figures each may cite: actual, budget, the day-10 forecast, variances and the drivers
options.action: Get the figures notes may cite

options.name: Submit Draft
options.description: Send a draft of one variance note with the figures it cites; Landledger refuses a figure that differs from the frozen snapshot (422), and only a person accepts a note

options.name: Seats
options.description: The contract that grants a Landbright app, its price per seat a month and the seats left (found: false when no contract names the app)

options.name: Query
options.description: Spend over a month or a range of days, grouped by a dimension (spend_by)

options.name: Window
options.description: The estimated cost of named services over a time window (each day's cost by the share of it inside the window); always labelled estimated
options.action: Get the cost of a window

options.name: Create
options.description: Raise a spend request (infra change, AI budget, tool or seat, other) for people to approve

options.name: Get
options.description: A request with its steps, decisions, reservations, Landledger's evidence and the evidence hash

options.name: List
options.description: Requests, newest first: waiting, mine, decided, open or all

options.name: Mark Applied
options.description: Tell Landledger an approved change is in place (approved → applied)

options.name: Cancel
options.description: Withdraw a request this key raised that is not decided yet (draft, awaiting confirmation or pending)

options.name: Release Seats
options.description: Give a seat request's seats back to the contract and release its reservations: access denied, the grant revoked, or not needed

options.name: Create
options.description: Reserve another month of an approved request's window (idempotent per month)

options.name: Release
options.description: Release a reservation (reserved → released)

options.name: Status
options.description: Whether a month is open, closing or locked, and who moved it

options.name: Who Am I
options.description: The key this node uses: its id (what a request's createdBy.id names when this key raised it), name and scopes

options.name: Relay
options.description: Carry a person's signed Slack press to Landledger as Slack sent it; Landledger verifies it and decides as the person who linked that Slack user. For flows only: refused when an agent or an MCP client calls it

properties.name: notice
properties.displayName: Decision → Relay carries a press exactly as Slack sent it (the Slack Trigger's Button Pressed rawBody and headers) with a key that holds only decisions:relay. Landledger checks Slack's signature with the relay channel's signing secret, the team and the app, finds the person who linked that Slack user from their own session, and decides as them only on the budget owner's step of an infra change, AI budget, tool or seat, or other request. The flow never names who decided. An agent never decides: this operation is refused when the node runs as an AI tool or over MCP.

nodes.name: landledgerTrigger
nodes.description: Starts the workflow when a Landledger request waits on its approvers or on a person's confirmation, is decided (also through a relay) or applied, a seat is released, a budget is at risk, a month starts closing, its notes are to be drafted or it is locked, or the exceptions report is stored (a signed webhook)
nodes.subtitle: {{events}}

properties.name: notice
properties.displayName: Give this trigger its own Landledger credential, with a key that holds only webhooks:write: publishing the workflow subscribes it in Landledger (POST /api/webhooks) and keeps the signing secret Landledger returns once, never shown; unpublishing deletes the subscription. Or have a Landledger admin add a webhook for this node's URL (Publish menu → App webhooks) with these events, and put its whsec_ secret in the credential's Webhook Signing Secret: then nothing is registered. Landledger must reach Landflow at the published URL (LANDFLOW_PUBLIC_URL). Every delivery is checked against its Standard Webhooks signature, at most 5 minutes old.

options.name: Request Step Pending
options.description: A step starts waiting on its approvers (or escalates): who they are, the evidence hash to relay with

options.name: Request Decided
options.description: A request ended: approved, rejected, cancelled or expired

options.name: Request Applied
options.description: The approved change is in place

options.name: Budget at Risk
options.description: A cost center crossed into at risk or over in a month

options.name: Period Closing
options.description: A month starts closing

options.name: Request Created
options.description: A request was submitted

options.name: Request Needs Confirmation
options.description: A key raised a request naming a person (requester or sponsor): they confirm it in Landledger before it goes to approvers

options.name: Decision Relayed
options.description: A person's press in a relay channel (Slack) was recorded as their decision

options.name: Exceptions Report
options.description: The weekly exceptions report was stored, with its sha256

options.name: Seat Released
options.description: A seat request's seats went back to its contract (released, or expired unapplied after 30 days)

options.name: Notes Draft Requested
options.description: The close reached the notes step (the accrual accepted, the snapshot frozen): the notes needed, with the figures each may cite

options.name: Note Accepted
options.description: An analyst accepted a variance note

options.name: Accrual Accepted
options.description: A controller accepted the month's accrual proposal

options.name: Period Locked
options.description: The second signature locked a month

options.name: Period Reopened
options.description: The CFO approved reopening a locked month

options.name: Datarails Uploaded
options.description: The month's snapshot and notes were uploaded to Datarails (or the upload failed)

properties.name: kinds

properties.name: costCenters

values.name: tolerance
values.description: How far the signed webhook-timestamp may be from now before the call is rejected as a replay (at most 300 s)

properties.name: baseUrl
properties.description: Landledger's API. On the OrbStack cluster the default; on this machine http://127.0.0.1:4810

properties.name: apiKey
properties.description: A Landledger API key (ll_…). For the Landledger node: read, and requests:write to raise requests (reservations:write to reserve and release). For a Landledger Trigger, a key of its own with only webhooks:write, so it subscribes itself on publish. Never decisions:relay: relays take a Landledger Relay Key credential

properties.name: webhookSecret
properties.description: Optional. The secret of a webhook subscription a Landledger admin made for the Landledger Trigger's URL. Set, the trigger registers nothing and checks deliveries with it; empty, the trigger subscribes itself on publish (the key needs webhooks:write) and keeps the secret Landledger returns, never shown

properties.name: baseUrl
properties.description: Landledger's API. On the OrbStack cluster the default; on this machine http://127.0.0.1:4810

properties.name: apiKey
properties.description: A Landledger API key with decisions:relay and nothing else (Landledger refuses a relay key with requests:write or admin; this test refuses any other write scope)

properties.name: baseUrl
properties.description: Landledger's API. On the OrbStack cluster the default; on this machine http://127.0.0.1:4810
